prompt:

Flat white and black only; no gray, shading, texture, glow, bevel, 3D, gradients, cube, code brackets, letters, text, captions, watermark or extra ornament. Keep the circle smooth, thin, unbroken and unchanged in spirit from the reference. Deliver one finished high-resolution icon, not a mockup or comparison sheet.
